t: Din met beshabbat ushear tiltul min hatztzad
s: Din met beshabbat ushear tiltul min hatztzad ubo t"v seipim: ap al pi shehammet hu muqtzeh veasur betiltul, ap al pi ken im hu muttal bemaqom sheyyare alayv mippene haddeleqa — muttar letaltelo kede lehatztzilo, shehittiru chakamim issur tiltul kede shello yabo lide issur chamur lekabbot et haddeleqa, mippene shehu bahul al meto shello yissarep. Umikkol maqom, kol mah sheepshar lo laasot yoter behetter — tzarik hu laasot, dehaynu im yesh lo dabar hammuttar betiltul shello letzorek gupo o meqomo, kegon tinoq, o kikkar, o shear okalin, o kol keli shemmelakto lehetter — metaltelo al yado, dehaynu shemmanniach dabar hammuttar al hammet o etzlo umetaltel shenehem keechad. Veim en lo dabar hammuttar betiltul, im hammet munnach al hammitta veyesh lo od mitta acheret — hopeko mimmitta zo lemitta zo umizzo lezo ad sheyyaggiennu lemaqom hamshummar min haddeleqa, shezzehu tiltul min hatztzad, vehammitta lo naaset basis lammet, hoil veen tzarik eleha, shekkol atzmo eno tzarik ella lahatilo al gabbe qarqa. Veim en lo mitta acheret — noseo bemitta zo, o apillu im eno munnach bammitta, metaltelo tiltul gamur beyadayv lehatztzilo min haddeleqa:

Veim i epshar lehatztzilo ki im al yede hotzaa lekarmelit — yesh mattirin mishshum bizyon hammet shello yissarep, sheggadol kebod habberiyyot sheddocheh mitzvat lo taaseh shebbattora, shehi "lo tasur min haddabar asher yaggidu leka vego'", shebbemitzva zo nitztavvinu lishmoa lekol dibre soperim, veissur hakkarmelit gam ken eno ella middibre soperim. Veap al pi ken, im yesh lo dabar hammuttar betiltul — tzarik lehotzio immo kede lehaqel issur hattiltul, sheap sheissur hakkarmelit nidcheh mippene kebod habberiyyot, mikkol maqom issur hattiltul, kevan sheepshar letaqqeno al yede tiltul dabar hammuttar — tzarik letaqqeno bekol mah deepshar. Veap shemmosip beissur hakkarmelit, shemmotzi immo gam haddabar hammuttar betiltul — en bekak kelum, sheissur hakkarmelit nidcheh kebar legamre behotzaat hammet. Abal issur hattiltul, kevan sheepshar letaqqeno en lanu lidchoto, shemmutab leharbot beissur echad millidchot shene issurim:

Met hammuttal bachamma veyare alayv pen yasriach, im yesh lo dabar hammuttar betiltul — metaltelo al yado mechamma letzel, veim lav — lo yetaltelennu kelal, apillu lehappeko mimmitta lemitta, shello hittiru tiltul min hatztzad ella keshemmetaltel letzorek dabar hammuttar kemo sheyyitbaer, abal kan hu metaltel letzorek hammet haasur betiltul. Velo hittiru mishshum kebod hammet ella issur hotzaa lekarmelit, shei epshar letaqqeno kelal keshetztzerikim lekak, abal issur tiltul, kevan sheepshar letaqqeno al yede sheyyetaltel immo dabar hammuttar — lo hittiruhu beshum inyan, apillu en lo dabar hammuttar, ella bidleqa bilbad hittiruhu, mishshum shello yabo lekabbot:

Vaapillu im yesh lo dabar hammuttar, ella sheen lo maqom sheyyesh bo tzel beotah reshut — asur lehotzio lekarmelit al yede dabar hammuttar, im epshar laasot lo taqqana al yede sheyyipresu machtzelaot letzel, kemo sheyyitbaer. Abal im i epshar bekak, veken met hammunnach babbayit vehu qarob lehasriach veen lo maqom qar beotah reshut lepannoto shamma — yesh mattirin lehotzio lekarmelit al yede dabar hammuttar, mishshum bizyon hammet shello yasriach. Abal im hisriach kebar babbayit verotzeh lehotzio kede lesalleq recho mibbene habbayit, im yesh lahem maqom acher latzet lesham — en motziin oto, ella mannichin oto bimqomo veyotzeim hem. Veim lav — muttar lehotzio, sheggadol kebod habberiyyot. Veken im rotzeh lehotzio mishshum kebodo shello yitbazzeh ben hachayyim — muttar lehotzio im en lahem maqom acher latzet lesham. Veken im hu muttal bebizzayon acher, kegon shehaya bispina vehayu hannokrim mitassepim sham, shezzehu bizzayon qetzat elayv — muttar lahabio derek karmelit labbayit al yede dabar hammuttar. Veken kol kayyotze bazeh:

Abal lehotzio lirshut harabbim gemura — asur apillu bidleqa. Vaapillu lehaomerim shehotzaat hammet enah asura min hattora ella middibre soperim mippene shehi melaka sheenah tzerika legupah, kemo shennitbaer besimman ra"ch, velo hittiruhu mishshum kebod habberiyyot, hoil veiqqarah min hattora, dehaynu im haya tzarik legupah, mah sheen ken hakkarmelit iqqarah middibre soperim:

Vaapillu al yede nokri asur birshut harabbim, mishshum sheggenay hu lammet sheyyomru habberiyyot nitchallel alayv shabbat chillul gamur, ap shennaasa hachillul al yede nokri, mah sheen ken hakkarmelit hakkol yodein sheenah biklal melakot veiqqarah middibre soperim:

Lo hittiru tiltul al yede dabar hammuttar ella bemet bilbad, abal shear debarim haasurim betiltul — asur letaltelam al yede dabar hammuttar, apillu im eno metaltel letzorek dabar haasur ella letzorek dabar hammuttar, shello hittiru tiltul al yede dabar acher letzorek dabar hammuttar, ella keshemmetaltel hahetter beyadayv vehaissur mittaltel immo, abal keshemmetaltel haissur beyadayv vehahetter mittaltel immo — lo hittiru ella bemet bilbad:

Vaapillu bemet lo hittiru ella mishshum kebodo, abal lo letzorek kohanim sheyyishshaaru bebattehem, o letzorek dabar acher, apillu hu debar mitzva. Abal muttar letaltelo al yede nokri letzorek mitzva, kegon chatunna, apilu shello al yede dabar hammuttar, shekkol shebut dishbut muttar bimqom mitzva. Veen tzarik lomar shebbekol maqom shemmuttar letaltelo al yede dabar hammuttar mishshum kebodo, shemmuttar letaltelo al yede nokri apillu shello al yede dabar hammuttar:

Vekol zeh betiltul gamur, abal tiltul min hatztzad, dehaynu lehappeko mimmitta lemitta — muttar apillu letzorek kohanim, o im tzarik limqom hammet, o laddabar shehammet munnach alayv, mippene shello aseru tiltul min hatztzad ella keshemmetaltel letzorek haissur, dehaynu letzorek hammet haasur betiltul, abal kan eno metaltel letzorek hammet ella letzorek dabar acher hammuttar. Veim en lo mitta acheret — muttar letaltelo bemitta zo, kevan shei epshar lenaarah lehappil oto mealeha laaretz, shehare shub lo yukal letaltelo betiltul min hatztzad, vekol shei epshar lenaarah — muttar letaltelah kedarkah kesheeno metaltel letzorek haissur, kemo shennitbaer besiman sh"t beshokeach eben al pi hechabit:

Lo hitzriku lehanniach al hammet dabar hammuttar betiltul ella bemet arum, o shehu labush betakrikim, shehen betelin etzlo, vaasurim betiltul kamohu. Abal met shehu labush bebigdo shehaya labush bo mechayyim — en tzarik lehanniach alayv kelum, shebbeged zeh hu muttar betiltul, sheeno batel etzlo, mippene sheatidim lehapshito mealayv ulehalbisho takrikim:

Met hammuttal bachamma veen lahem maqom lepannoto, o shello ratzu lahazizo mimmeqomo — muttar laasot alayv ohel aray al yede haarama letzorek hachay. Ketzad? Baim shene bene adam veyoshebim mishshene tzedadayv al gabbe qarqa, cham lahem millematta mechom haqqarqa shertacho chamma — zeh mebi mittato veyosheb aleha, vezeh mebi mittato veyosheb aleha, cham lahem milmala — zeh mebi machatzelet upores al gabbayv letzel, vezeh mebi machatzelet upores al gabbayv, zeh zoqep mittato umesirah mishsham venishmat veholek lo, vezeh zoqep umesir mittato venishmat veholek lo, venimtzet mechitztza asuya meeleha, shehare machatzelet zeh umachatzelet zeh gabbehen semukot zo lazo, ushene qetzotehen al haqqarqa mishshene tzidde hammet, shehittiru laasot ohel aray bishbil tzaar hachay velo bishbil hammet, velaken hitzriku sheyyeshebu mittechilla ad sheyyicham lahem millematta, veaz yabiu mittot lesheb alehen, ap sheen bammittot tzorek kelal laasiyyat haohel, kede sheyyehe nireh shepperisat hammachtzelaot enah kede laasot ohel al hammet bechibbur shettehen, ella kede lipros kol echad al atzmo lehagen mippene hachamma, shehare gam keshecham lahem millematta hebi kol echad mittato veyashebu alehen. Umittaam zeh tzerikim lizqop ulehasir mittatam mishsham velaamod perisat hammachtzelaot, kede sheggam bazeh yehe nireh shepperisat hammachtzelaot lo hayeta bishbil hammet ella lehagen alehem mippene hachamma, shehare keshecham lo millematta hebi mitta veyashab aleha ukesheamad zeqapah vehalak lo:

Muttar lasuk et hammet velahadicho, ubilbad shello yaziz bo shum eber, shekkol muqtzeh keshem sheasur letaltel kullo — kak asur letaltel miqtzato. Vaapillu al yede dabar hammuttar asur letaltelo kede lerochotzo, ella im ken haya metunnap betit vetzoa ad shemmaus beene roayv, shello hittiru tiltul bammet al yede dabar hammuttar ella lehatztzilo mibbizzayon, kegon bemuttal bachamma shello yasriach o bizzayon acher, kemo shennitbaer lemala. Velaken tzarik limchot bemah shennahagu lehagbiah hammet meal hakkarim al yede dabar hammuttar ap bemaqom sheen lachush shemma yasriach. Veap im yesh lachush sheyyasriach mechom hakkarim — shometin hakkarim mittachtayv veen metaltelim oto. Umuttar lezallep chometz al gabbe begadim shel hammet bishbil shello yasriach lemotzae shabbat veyukelu lehitasseq betohorato, veen kan mishshum libbun, shehachometz eno melabben, ugezera shemma yischot gam ken en gozerin ella bemashqeh hamlabben, kemo shennitbaer besiman sh"a:

Im haya piv niptach veholek — qosher et hallechi beinyan shello yosip lehippateach, abal lo kede sheyyissager mah shenniptach o qetzato, shehare asur lehaziz eber. Umittaam zeh en maatzimin enayv shel met beshabbat. Veakshav nahagu lehaatzim enayv beshabbat ulehaziz eber shello yitaqqem, veomerim sheyyesh sakkana bedabar, veen limchot beyadam:

Zeh hakkelal betiltul al yede dabar acher: kol shene debarim echad asur letaltelo veechad muttar letaltelo, vehem semukim zeh lazeh o zeh bazeh o zeh al zeh, vehu beinyan shello naasa hahetter basis laissur al derek shennitbaer besiman sh"t, ubizman shemmetaltel echad mehem mittaltel immo hashsheni, im metaltel haissur beyado vehahetter mittaltel immo — lo hittiruhu beshum inyan ella bemet bilbad. Vaapillu im metaltel hahetter beyadayv vehaissur mittaltel immo, im hu mitkavven betiltul zeh letzorek haissur, en tzarik lomar im metaltel letzorek haissur atzmo kede leshomro meezeh qilqul vehepsed, o kede lehatznio, o ezeh inyan acher, ella apillu im metaltel mippene shetztzarik lo haissur lehishtammesh bo ezeh tashmish hammuttar, kegon lesheb o lishkab alayv, shezzehu muttar, kemo shennitbaer besiman sh"ch, o kegon ner lehishtammesh leoro bemaqom acher vekol kayyotze bazeh, hoil umittaltel bishbil haissur — asur. Abal im eno tzarik kelal legup haissur, veeno metaltelo al yede hahetter ella bishbil dabar hammuttar, kegon lepannot meqomo — zehu tiltul min hatztzad shehittiru chakamim, al derek shennitbaer besiman sh"t beeben sheal pi hechabit umaot sheal hakkar. Veen tzarik lomar im eno mitkavven kelal letiltul haissur, sheeno tzarik lo kelal raq tiltul hahetter bilbad, ella shei epshar lo letaltel hahetter ella im ken yetaltel haissur al yado, kegon tzenon talush hattamun baaretz umiqtzat alayv megullin — notelo bahem umotzio, ap al pi shebbintilato meziz apar mimmeqomo. Vehu shello hishrish, sheaz en bo mishshum tolesh ap im nitkavven lizria keshettemano sham, kemo shennitbaer besiman sh"y. Veap im hosip mechamat lachut haqqarqa — en bekak kelum kol shello hishrish. Vehatztzenon lo naasa basis leheapar shealayv, ap im haya bedato sheyyishshaer munnach sham kol hashshabbat, mippene shello hayeta kavvanato sheyyehe hatztzenon meshammesh leheapar, ella sheyyehe heapar meshammesh lehatztzenon. Veken bekol kayyotze bazeh. Veim en miqtzat alayv megullin — yesh mattirin litchob kush o sakkin letok hatztzenon ulehotzio bahem, veheapar sheal gabbayv ninar meelayv. Veap shebbitchillat hagbahato et hatztzenon magbiah gam heapar shealayv — en bekak kelum, kevan shebbishbil dabar hammuttar hu. Veyesh oserin litchob beapar, mippene shennireh keoseh guma. Uleinyan halaka, bedibre soperim — hallek achar hammeqel. Abal perot hattemunim beqash o teben hammuqtzim lehassaqa — muttar ledibre hakkol litchob kush o sakkin letok happerot ulehotziam, sheen issur guma shayyak ella beapar vekayyotze bo, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tq"v. Veim yiched haqqash vehatteben lehatmin bahem happerot — yatzeu mittorat muqtzeh umuttarim betiltul. Veken haddin beapar sheyyichado lekak, kemo shennitbaer:

Vekol zeh betiltul beyadayv al yede dabar acher, abal letaltel hammuqtzeh begupo shello beyadayv — muttar apillu metaltelo letzorek haissur, kegon qash shehu muqtzeh mippene shessetamo omed lehassaqa, veim hu natun al hammitta shello lishkab alayv ubeshabbat hu ba lishkab alayv — muttar lenaanea begupo kede sheyyehe tzap verak venoach lishkab alayv. Veim hinniach alayv mibbeod yom kar o sadin — naasa kemo sheyyashab o shakab alayv mibbeod yom, vahare zeh mukan lishiba o lishkiba, umeatta yesh torat keli alayv umuttar letaltelo beyadayv. Veken im chashab alayv mibbeod yom lesheb o lishkab alayv, kemo shennitbaer besiman sh"ch, bedabar sheddarko gam ken leyachado lishiba o lishkiba. Veim hizmino lemaakal behema mibbeod yom — muttar letaltelo bekol inyan. Vekol zeh bimqomot shessetam qash omed lehassaqa, abal bimqomot shessetamo omed lemaakal behema o lishkiba — muttar letaltelo bekol inyan, kemo shennitbaer sham:
